excerpt: Rupeek is a Bengaluru online gold loan platform that arranges loans through partner banks. How it works, funding, its 2024 down round and alternatives.
content:
Rupeek is an Indian fintech company that arranges gold loans, where you pledge gold jewellery as security for a loan. It was founded in 2015 in Bengaluru by Sumit Maniyar and Ashwin Soni. Rupeek is not itself the bank: loans are made by partner lenders such as Federal Bank, and the gold is kept in the partner bank's vault. Its website says the gold is insured by The New India Assurance Company while it is in Rupeek's process.

Customers can book an appointment at a partner bank branch, where a Rupeek loan manager values the gold and the money is transferred before the customer leaves, or use the doorstep service in supported cities. The site advertises gold loans in about 30 minutes for select schemes, online repayment, part-release of gold, and a 'Shift your loan' option to move an existing gold loan from another lender. It also promotes a Rupeek Gold Card with 0% interest for up to 45 days, for select schemes.

Rupeek raised money from Accel, Sequoia Capital India (now Peak XV), GGV Capital, Bertelsmann and Binny Bansal, among others; Inc42 put its total funding at more than $164 million. In 2022 it was valued at about $600 million. In May 2024 Inc42 reported that it raised INR 51 crore from 360 One Large Value Fund and BlackSoil at a valuation of about INR 1,785 crore ($213 million), a 64.5% fall: a down round. Entrackr reported in June 2024 that Elevation Capital put in a further INR 125 crore. For FY23 Inc42 reported operating revenue of INR 88.9 crore and a net loss of INR 281.6 crore.

Rupeek's homepage description advertises rates from 0.55% without stating the period; the actual rate depends on the lender, scheme and loan amount, so check the loan offer before pledging gold.

This profile is put together from the company's own pages and published reporting, checked on 15 October 2026. We have not tested the product, and nothing here is paid placement.

use_cases: Taking a loan against gold jewellery
Moving an existing gold loan to a lower rate
Getting short-term credit quickly without income documents

fit: own gold jewellery and need a short-term loan in a city Rupeek serves
want the gold held by a bank rather than a pawnbroker
want to compare an existing gold loan's rate
not_fit: do not want to pledge gold
live in an area Rupeek and its partner banks do not serve

faq.q: Who lends the money in a Rupeek gold loan?
faq.a: Partner banks such as Federal Bank; Rupeek arranges the loan and the gold is kept in the bank's vault.
Sumit Maniyar and Ashwin Soni, in 2015, according to Inc42.

faq.q: Is my gold insured with Rupeek?
faq.a: Rupeek's site says the gold is insured by The New India Assurance Company during the process.
